record.description: A two-tier hanging window perch that lets cats rest up high and watch the outdoors. It attaches to glass with nut suction cups and holds up to 55 pounds. The metal frame is covered by a removable plush mattress that can be machine washed. It suits windows about 17.7 inches wide or more.

A women's wrap-style slipper with a grippy outsole for traction on smooth floors. It comes in black and a medium width, sized for a US women's 5. The design suits casual wear around the house and short trips outdoors.
A long buffalo plaid table runner in black and white, sized to cover a banquet or dining table for eight to ten guests. It adds a rustic farmhouse touch to holiday, wedding, and party decor.

A black linerlock folding pocket knife from the Case Harley Tec X line. The compact folded body measures about thirteen centimeters tall in its packaging. The package weighs roughly 0.14 kilograms and the knife is made in China.

A red indoor cycling bike built for cardio sessions at home. A 30-pound flywheel and a manual resistance control let you adjust effort. The model includes Bluetooth connectivity, making it a stationary option for intense workouts.

A camouflage-print school backpack for elementary-age children, sized about 17 by 12 by 6 inches. It has four compartments of different sizes plus two mesh side pockets for organizing books and supplies. Adjustable straps and a water-resistant build suit everyday use.

A set of two airy linen-blend curtain panels with nickel grommet tops, each 52 by 84 inches. The open weave gives a soft, natural look that lets light through while still reducing glare. The relaxed draped style suits living rooms and bedrooms.

A single 0.4 fluid ounce bottle of long-wearing nail color from the Sally Hansen Xtreme Wear line. The formula is marketed as hard-wearing and offers a bright shine. It comes in a current trend shade for a fresh manicure look.

A black mug tree that holds cups of every size by their handles, keeping them off the counter. Its clean lines suit a range of kitchen styles. It doubles as a countertop organizer for a coffee station.

A men's Full Swing Cryder jacket from Carhartt in the Shadow colorway, sized medium. It is water repellent and built with stretch fabric for free movement. Flexible elbows and back panels are designed to reduce restriction when you move.

A foldable laundry basket with two removable dirty-clothes bags, so one can be swapped out while the other is washed. It holds about 74 liters and stands roughly 24.5 inches tall. The grey hamper folds flat for storage and travel.

A prize figure of the Echidna character from the Re:Zero anime, produced by Taito under official license. It includes a base stand to display the figure on a shelf. This is the mandarin dress version of the Coreful figure line.

A women's down jacket with 700-fill-power goose down insulation and a waterproof, breathable outer shell. It has a removable hood that fits over a helmet, a zippered waist pocket, and adjustable cuffs. The black XL version is built for cold, wet weather.

Ankle-height baby socks with rubber grips on the soles to help toddlers keep their footing on smooth floors. They are sized for children aged 12 to 36 months. The grips are arranged as dots, smaller at the edges and larger in the middle.

An unframed canvas print of Edward Hopper's People in the Sun, sized 50 by 80 centimeters. It is inkjet printed in high resolution on glossy canvas. The piece works as wall art for living rooms, bedrooms, or offices.

A fitted, solid grey dress shirt from Van Heusen, sized 17.5 neck with 36 to 37 inch sleeves. Its wrinkle-free fabric is made for easy care. The point collar and adjustable cuffs suit business and formal occasions.

A classic red steel wagon with 10-inch rubber tires for a smooth ride over bumps. The seamless steel body and undercarriage are built for hauling toddlers and cargo. The extra-long pull handle folds under for storage.

A wireless full-coverage bra in star white, sized 38C, with lightly lined cups. Its back straps convert between traditional and crisscross styles. The silky fabric is meant to sit smoothly under clothing.

A set of four 24-ounce cereal bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade polypropylene. They are lightweight, unbreakable, and free of BPA. The bowls are labeled safe for both dishwashers and microwaves.

A single dark blue cake topper marking a baby boy's first birthday. It is made from card stock with a sparkly blue glitter layer. The topper works as a cake decoration and as a photo booth prop at a one-year party.

A sintered bronze flanged sleeve bearing with a 12 millimeter inside diameter and a 15 millimeter outside diameter. It is self-lubricating and follows the SAE 841 Oilite standard. The copper-colored bearing is made for machinery where maintenance-free operation matters.

A compact 24-inch large-format plotter for architects and engineers working from a home or small office. It handles sheet and roll media and includes an automatic cutter. Mobile printing is supported over its wireless connection.

A five-pack of sleeveless white bodysuits for babies aged six to twelve months. The soft, flexible fabric stretches in four directions. Expandable shoulders make dressing easier, and reinforced snaps add durability.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls in 1.5, 3, and 5 quart sizes for whisking, mixing, and marinating. The set was rated highly in a test kitchen for mixing performance and durability. It suits everyday cooking tasks.

A short-sleeved A-line summer dress in burnt orange with an all-over print and a V neckline. It has a high waist and butterfly sleeves. The fabric does not stretch, and the dress can be washed by machine or by hand.

A women's neck lanyard with a cactus plant print in green, designed to hold an ID badge and work keys. It is made of soft polyester that stays comfortable against the neck for long wear. A metal key clasp keeps keys attached securely.

A short-sleeved Halloween graphic tee for women, printed with a Sanderson Sisters quote. It is made of a soft, stretchy cotton blend that feels breathable to wear. The shirt suits seasonal parties and casual everyday outings.
A small bi-fold wallet for women in a stitched pink finish, made from embossed genuine leather. It includes RFID blocking and a zippered pocket for coins. The compact size fits easily into a purse.

A set of eight roll-up travel storage bags, including three suitcase-sized and five carry-on-sized bags. They are designed to compress clothing and save space while packing. Use them to organize clothes for trips.

A women's running shoe with a rearfoot gel cushioning system to soften impact during each stride. It has a removable sockliner for a more adjustable fit. The design suits moderate-mileage runners who want comfort and durability.

A three-cube open-back storage organizer in white, measuring about 44 inches tall, 16 inches wide, and 13.5 inches deep. Each cube fits 13-inch decorative fabric storage bins. Its sturdy frame is finished on both the front and back.

A brown vintage-style flap tote with a top handle and a chain shoulder strap. It is made of patent PU leather with a soft polyester lining. Its briefcase shape and shiny finish give it a classic, retro look.

A slim clear protective case for the iPhone XR with a frosted PC back and a soft TPU bumper. The case supports wireless charging and has a floral design. Its edges are shaped to sit level with the phone's screen.
A black infant bodysuit printed with a famous 90s sitcom quote. It is made of pre-shrunk, soft ring-spun cotton and has a snap crotch for easy changing. The item is printed in the USA.
A women's western cowboy boot from Ariat in a brown and chocolate floral finish, sized 11 M US. It has a Duratread outsole. The Dahlia style suits Western-inspired outfits.

Electric running boards for 2016 to 2019 Nissan Titan and Titan XD trucks in black. They extend automatically when the door opens and retract when it closes. The boards include an integrated LED light and are built from die-cast aluminum.
A women's sterling silver box chain necklace with a lobster claw clasp. It is 0.8 millimeters wide, sleek, and designed to lie along the collarbone. The 925 silver is polished to a smooth shine.
A jumbo shark-shaped pencil eraser in green for correcting big mistakes. It suits school, homework, and office use. The novelty eraser also makes a fun back-to-school gift.

A short-sleeved striped midi dress for work, church, or casual events, with navy lines over a flowered print. It is made of 100% polyester. The listing advises sizing up, since the dress tends to run slightly small.

A chrome 2.2 gallon-per-minute aerator for Delta Neo Style lavatory faucets. It has a 55/64-inch, 27-thread female connection. The part replaces the aerator that controls water flow at a bathroom sink.

A slim-fit men's button-up shirt in bright white, with rolled sleeves. It is made of a lightweight linen and cotton blend that allows air to circulate. The shirt is a versatile wardrobe staple for spring and summer.
A men's lightweight V-neck pocket t-shirt in pampas yellow, sized large. It is cut close to the body for a slim silhouette. The soft jersey slub cotton is light and comfortable for warm-weather wear.

A black rubber ramp cleat floor mat, 3 by 4 feet and 1/8 inch thick. It is designed to add non-slip traction on moist floors, indoors or outdoors. The mat is affordable and light enough to move easily.
A white cotton throw measuring 50 by 60 inches with decorative fringe. Its vintage or distressed look works well with rustic décor. The fringe is finished to hold up through washing.

A 10-inch heavyweight aluminum pan for baking classic angel food cakes. Its nonstick coating helps cakes release easily and simplifies cleanup. The pan is made in the USA and is recommended for hand washing.

A clear slim-fit case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max with a hard plastic back and flexible bumper. It is designed to show the phone's original look with high clarity and resist yellowing. The shockproof case fits closely to the device.
A men's black oxford with a bike-toe shape and blind-eyelet lacing. The moisture-wicking lining is meant to keep feet comfortable. It has a PU outsole with shock-absorbing points.

A walk-through baby gate that expands to fit openings between 29 and 38 inches or 42 and 47 inches wide. It stands 30 inches tall and uses a pressure mount for quick setup. The kit includes extension pieces and wall cups for mounting.

A low-cut men's turf soccer shoe from adidas in core black with white and red accents. It has a regular fit and a 3D-printed strike zone for ball control. The shoe is designed for play on artificial turf.

A sand-colored triangular sun shade sail measuring 12 feet per side. It is made of 185 GSM high-density polyethylene that blocks up to 95 percent of UV rays while letting air and water pass through. It suits patios, gardens, pools, and BBQ areas.

High-waisted flared palazzo pants in chakra blue, sized small and offered in regular and plus sizes. The high waistband is meant to stay in place without digging in. The wide-leg, flowy cut suits a relaxed boho look.

A queen-size grey reversible comforter with two matching pillow shams, measuring 88 by 92 inches. Its brushed microfiber fabric is soft and plush, and the down-alternative fill aims to be warm without extra weight. It is designed for year-round use.

A black LED headlamp with an 800-lumen Cree XM-L T6 bulb and a zoomable beam. It offers high, low, and strobe modes, with a reach of over 20 feet on the brightest setting. It suits running, hiking, camping, and fishing.

A five-count box of lemon vanilla protein wafer crisps with a sweet vanilla coating and lemon filling. Each wafer provides 11 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber. The snack is low in sugar and designed to fit a keto-friendly diet.

Mid-rise bootcut jeans for women from Ariat, sized 28 regular, in an entwined pattern. The flame-resistant fabric includes stretch for easy movement. They pair well with work shirts, tees, and ankle boots.

Women's grey slip-on house slippers lined with soft fleece and finished with a faux-wool plush top. The solid rubber sole gives non-slip grip indoors and outdoors. They are machine washable for easy care.

Relaxed straight-fit carpenter jeans in timber, sized 34 by 34. They are made of lightweight 100% cotton duck fabric that is garment washed for softness. The pockets include a utility pocket and a hammer loop, with room for bending and kneeling.

A matching stainless steel ring set for couples, with a cubic zirconia round-cut stone on the women's band. The men's band has a comfort-fit design and a high polish. The set is sized women's 7 and men's 10.

A universal mount that lets binoculars without a threaded tripod socket attach to a tripod. It uses a standard quarter-inch, 20-thread screw. The mount is compatible with a wide range of binocular models.

A women's black spa thong slipper with a plush terry upper and a classic flip-flop design. It has a memory foam insole with arch support. The skid-resistant, weatherproof sole suits indoor and outdoor wear.

Moderate graduated compression socks for women in black, sized M/L. They are designed for all-day wear, flights, and long stretches of sitting or standing. The socks suit people on their feet through long shifts or during exercise.
A loose-fitting floral tunic top in solid black, sized large. It has 3/4 roll-tab sleeves and a notch V neckline with a collar detail. The relaxed fit is intended to pair well with leggings.

A black luggage strap from Samsonite that fits bags up to 72 inches around. Its rugged ABS buckle and polypropylene strap are built to handle baggage crews. The distinct design helps identify luggage on a carousel. It comes without a lock.

A women's taupe ankle bootie with a V cutout at the front and a chunky stacked block heel, sized 6 medium US. It has a closed, pointed toe and an inner zipper for easy on and off. The classic western style works with many outfits.
A set of 69 Futurama-themed sticker decals for kids and adults. Each sticker is roughly one to two inches across. They suit laptops, skateboards, backpacks, and luggage.
A women's black and white sandal from Crocs' LiteRide line, sized 8. The stretch straps and cushioned design are built for comfort at any pace. The sandal suits everyday wear and walking.

A funny birthday greeting card from Hallmark with modern lettering on a sunrise background. The humorous message suits a friend or relative who appreciates a light joke. It works as a shoebox-style card for a birthday celebration.

Women's everyday flat shoes with a knit upper and cotton lining, sized 35. They have a leather insole with arch support and a lightweight jelly outsole with slip resistance. The shoes are machine washable for easy care.
A lightweight classic-fit graphic t-shirt with a Switzerland and Alps design. It features double-needle stitching on the sleeves and hem. The shirt suits travel, hiking, and souvenir gifting.

A 25-foot foil-backed natural cotton pipe wrap for insulating heating and AC ducts. It is 3 inches wide and carries a Class A fire rating. Installation is simple and requires no gloves, face mask, or goggles.

An espresso and cappuccino machine with a 20-bar pump and up to 1,350 watts of power. It has a steam nozzle for frothing milk and a 6-cup water tank. The brushed stainless steel body fits well on a kitchen counter.
A 20-inch freestyle BMX bike with a rotor, front and rear U-brakes, and front and rear pegs. It has 48-spoke wheels and a deluxe paint finish. It is built for tricks and everyday riding.

A walnut jewelry armoire with drawers and double hooks for necklaces and bracelets. It measures about 41 inches tall, 17 inches wide, and 12.5 inches deep. It combines solid wood with high-density fiberboard and veneer.

An inflatable water park measuring 18 by 17 by 9.5 feet, with a splash pool, climbing wall, and two slides. A water cannon and slide sprayers add splash play. It includes a carry bag and a repair kit.

A wired USB optical mouse with three buttons and 1000 DPI resolution for everyday office and study tasks. It has a rubber scroll wheel and works with Windows and Mac computers. Its portable design suits laptops and desktops alike.

A women's mid-calf winter boot from Sorel in dark gray and black, sized 9. Its waterproof suede uppers and vulcanized rubber shell are paired with a warm faux fur lining. A shearling cuff and bonded felt frost plug add comfort in cold, wet weather.

Faux mink individual eyelash extensions with a 0.25 CC curl, offered in lengths from 8 to 20 millimeters. They are sold for salon use and are meant to shorten application time. The range lets stylists match a variety of client requests.

A two-pack of men's long-sleeve DryBlend t-shirts in sport grey, sized medium. The longer dropped shoulder and wider, shorter sleeves are meant to fit comfortably. The stay-cool fabric wicks moisture, and neck tape reinforces the collar.

An underwire minimizer bra in body beige, sized 40D. Its two-ply back and supportive fabric provide smoothing and shaping. The wider-set straps and open neckline offer a comfortable fit with the right amount of coverage.

A 48-inch yellow folding gymnastics wedge mat with a 15.5-degree incline. It suits tumbling, stretching, yoga, and aerobics at home. The inclined shape is intended to support comfortable practice for kids and adults.

A large wearable wrap sack for babies weighing 7 to 14 pounds, roughly 0 to 3 months old. It can be worn with arms in, arms out, or one of each. A bottom zipper allows diaper changes without unwrapping the baby.

A 14-karat white gold pendant charm in the shape of the number 1, laser etched for a fine finish. It measures about 14.32 millimeters long and 3.81 millimeters wide. The hypoallergenic piece is presented as a gift for her.

A slim clear case for the iPhone X and XS that adds impact protection with D3O material. The material is described as among the thinnest and most advanced protection against knocks and drops. The design aims to stay tough without bulk.
Women's grey and black winter ankle boots in size 9 medium. The padded collar and faux fur lining add warmth and a close, cozy fit. The boot suits fall and winter wear.
Men's slim-fit bootcut jeans in black, sized 34 by 28. They have classic five-pocket styling and a bit of stretch to help them keep their shape. The jeans suit everyday wear.

A women's reversible nylon slip-thru strap watch from Timex with a round white dial. It has a polished silver-tone 38-millimeter case, Arabic numerals, and an Indiglo light for reading in the dark. One side of the strap shows a floral and swirl print.

Low-rise cargo scrub pants for women in black, sized XX-large petite. They have a drawstring waistband, multiple pockets including one for scissors, and adjustable ankle toggles. A D-ring on the left leg adds a practical attachment point.

A one-piece swimsuit for little girls with a dog print, sized 7T to 8T. It is made of a stretchy blend of 80% polyamide and 20% elastane. The smooth fabric fits comfortably and dries fairly quickly after use.

An officially licensed Marvel graphic t-shirt featuring Miles Morales from Spider-Man. It has a lightweight classic fit with double-needle stitching on the sleeves and hem. The shirt suits fans of the Spider-Verse character.

A set of 10 washable hair chalks in bright colors for temporary hair color. The colors are not permanent and wash out, making them useful for dress-up, parties, and cosplay. The set is intended for children aged four and up.
A three-pair pack of women's black ultra-low liners with a mesh top and cushioned sole. Silicone grips at the heel help them stay in place. They are sized 9 to 11 and fit shoe sizes 4 through 10.

A 5.2-channel home theater receiver with 4K Ultra HD video support and built-in Bluetooth. It delivers 140 watts per channel and supports HDR, HLG, and BT.2020 for a realistic picture. It also has a USB port and works with HEOS Link for wireless audio.

A foldable portable vocal booth with a reflection filter and microphone isolation shield for home recording. Its interior measures about 12 by 14 by 16 inches, and it folds down to a compact size. The booth is designed to isolate sound during recording.

specs.material: cotton canvas with polyester mesh back

record.description: A musk green canvas cap with a polyester mesh back from Carhartt. It has a structured, medium-profile fit with a pre-curved visor. The sweatband is designed to fight odor, and the fabric wicks sweat for comfort.

A black laser projector with built-in Android TV that projects images up to 150 inches. Its picture is designed to stay bright and colorful even with the lights on. It can be used on most walls or on a dedicated screen.
Women's black and white retro tennis-style sneakers from Nike's Court Royale line, sized 8.5 regular US. They take their look from vintage tennis styling. The sneakers suit everyday wear.

A waterproof travel organizer bag for cables, chargers, USB drives, and small devices. It has two zippered openings and a two-layer nylon interior with several compartments. The bag fits accessories such as a mouse, charger, and mini tablet.

A women's tote in hushed turquoise with a water-resistant finish. It has a large main compartment, a wordmark zipper pull, and double webbing straps for carrying. The bag is sized for everyday travel and errands.

A Nike Air Zoom Mariah Flyknit Racer sneaker in size 10.5. It updates the original Air Mariah silhouette with modern technology and lightweight construction. The sneaker suits everyday wear and casual outfits.

A magnetic fiberglass screen door net that fits doors up to 36 inches wide and 80 inches tall. It includes hook and loop tape, push pins, and an instruction manual for quick installation and removal. The mesh is reinforced to resist tearing.

A 5-by-8-foot shaggy area rug with a plush pile about 1.5 inches thick, designed for bedrooms and living rooms. It is soft underfoot and meant to be a comfortable place to relax. The rug arrives vacuum-packed, so it may need a few days to lose wrinkles and odor.

A long-sleeved men's popover shirt with a mandarin collar in blue, sized 3XL. It is made of an 80% cotton and 20% polyester oxford fabric that is thick enough to avoid showing through. The shirt is designed to hold its shape well.

A 3-by-10-foot golf putting training mat with a premium turf surface designed to feel like a real green. The usable putting area is about 2 by 8.5 feet inside the border. It includes two putting holes with flags.

A manual-focus 35mm F1.2 lens in black for APS-C Canon EOS-M mirrorless cameras. Its large aperture allows bright images and shallow depth of field. The focal length is equivalent to about 53mm on APS-C bodies.

Ivory flameless LED candles, each 6 by 3.25 inches, with a flickering moving flame. They are waterproof, so they can be used outdoors without melting. The candles run on batteries and come with a remote and timers.

A men's thermal base layer shirt in black and blue, sized L/XL. It is designed for autumn and winter activities such as hiking, cycling, skiing, and training. The breathable functional fabric is meant to be worn close to the skin.

A 30-centimeter USB to DC charging cable with a 2.0 by 12.0 millimeter tip for Mini S530 wireless earbuds and related Bluetooth devices. It works as a replacement when a charger is lost. The cable is sold as a single piece.
A 13-inch cube storage box made of polyester, designed for kids and toddlers. It fits most cube shelving units and has a front tab for easy pulling. The box is decorated with a felt dog appliqué.

A grey insulated double-deck lunch bag with a 15-liter capacity. The two layers keep different foods separate so they do not get squeezed. Its wide mouth makes it easy to fill, and the bag is leakproof.
A set of four handcrafted stoneware rice bowls in a multicolor design, made in England. They are safe for the oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher. The bowls suit everyday meals.

A corrugated cardboard cat scratcher shaped as a chaise lounge, with catnip infused into each layer. The catnip is released with every scratch, which reduces mess. The piece gives cats a place to scratch and rest.
A sleeveless lace fit-and-flare midi dress in navy, sized medium. It is partially lined and has a contemporary fit that runs small. Check the size chart before ordering.
An 8.4-fluid-ounce bath and shower gel with a cherry blossom fragrance. It is designed to cleanse gently and leave the skin lightly perfumed. The product is listed as suitable for sensitive skin.
A WIX 57502XP oil filter for automotive engines, with a package weight of about 0.75 pounds. The package measures roughly 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches. The filter is made in China.

A sand-free beach blanket measuring 82.7 by 78.7 inches, suitable for four to eight adults. Its waterproof, lightweight design folds to a compact size and dries quickly. The sandproof surface is meant to keep sand from clinging.
A navy and grey kids' boat shoe from Sperry Top-Sider in big kid size 5. It works as a sneaker that doubles as a dress shoe for kids who do not like dressing up. The shoe suits everyday school wear.
Women's short black fashion boots from UGG, sized 8 medium US. They have a soft suede upper and a 17-millimeter UGGpure lining and insole. The Treadlite outsole is intended for everyday wear.
A glossy pink vinyl apron that is waterproof and stain-resistant. It is ultra lightweight and suits cooking, food prep, grooming, and garage or garden work. The durable vinyl is easy to wipe clean.

A full-motion wall mount bracket for TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches, supporting up to 33 pounds. It is compatible with 75 by 75 and 100 by 100 millimeter VESA patterns. The mount tilts and swivels and suits corner installation.

A fan-shaped hanging corner shelf in distressed brown, made of lightweight paulownia wood. Each board has an 11-inch radius and is 0.7 inches thick. The jute rope hanging design suits farmhouse storage in living rooms and bedrooms.
A set of coordinating cotton dresses for baby girls aged 12 to 18 months, in a blueberry print. The soft cotton is gentle on skin and suits everyday wear. It is sold as an affordable value pack.
A 50-count pack of odor-control pads with a Febreze freshness scent. The pads neutralize strong ammonia odors and have a rapid-drying top layer to limit tracking. A gel layer locks in liquid.

A two-pack of collapsible wall-mounted drying racks that fold away when not in use. They are designed to add drying space in small rooms and closets. The racks help make the most of existing closet space.

A mesh oversize load banner with grommets, measuring 18 by 84 inches. It alerts passing traffic to a wide load and is required by most states for hauling large loads. It is used on equipment and other oversize loads.

A set of 48 neon green floating practice golf balls for water use. Each ball has a two-piece construction with 432 dimples and a 90 compression rating. The set comes with a carry bag and suits pool or pond practice.

A compact countertop dishwasher with a stainless steel interior and a rack for six place settings. It offers six wash cycles and delay start options of two to eight hours. A universal faucet adapter connects it to most kitchen faucets.

A children's kit for making Butterfinger-style cake pops without an oven. The set includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other baking tools. It is designed for kids to make treats quickly at home.

A swivel faucet aerator that rotates 720 degrees to direct water across the whole sink. It can be bent or folded to suit the job and is designed to reduce splashing. It attaches to kitchen or bathroom faucets to help save water.

Men's grey, green, and black golf shoes from adidas, sized 10 US. They have a lace closure, a regular fit, and a Bounce midsole with Boost in the heel. The upper uses recycled materials as part of the Primegreen line.
A natural straw Carolina hat for men from Stetson and Dobbs, sized XL. It has an outback style with a vented crown for airflow. It suits sunny days spent outdoors.

A set of two plastic apothecary jars, 15 and 20 ounces, for bathroom vanity storage. The smaller jar holds cotton swabs, and the larger one holds cotton balls, rounds, or bath salts. The set adds organized storage to a vanity.

A dual-layer protective case for the Samsung Galaxy On5 with a brushed metal texture. It includes a card slot, a kickstand, and a locking swivel belt clip. The package also includes tempered glass for the screen.

An electric facial hair remover for women with a powerful motor and dual stainless steel blades. It is designed to be gentle and is described as suitable for all skin types and tones. The kit includes an additional replacement head.

A double-layer camping hammock made of 210T nylon in one seamless piece. Each face can be black or orange, and it is designed for backpacking, hiking, and travel. The hammock includes a tree strap for setup.
A hooded reindeer costume for dogs in medium, designed for Christmas or winter-themed parties. It closes with Velcro at the neck and chest. The costume gives dog owners a festive seasonal look.

A wooden electric standing desk with dual motors that raise and lower it between 29 and 49 inches. The tilt feature adjusts the desktop angle from 13 to 45 degrees. The frame supports up to 165 pounds and includes USB charging ports.

A ten-piece set of hand-painted pirate figurines with a cannon, treasure chest, eye patch, and X-marks-the-spot flag. The figures are about one to three inches tall and suit play and pirate-themed parties. The set is a fun gift for kids.

A blue performance insole for men's footwear, sized 9 to 10.5. It has a contoured neutral arch intended to suit most foot types. The insert fits casual and athletic shoes for walking, running, and cross-training.

A mid-century modern accent armchair in azure upholstered fabric from Modway. Its curved back, cut-out silhouette, and gentle recline give it an organic look. It suits contemporary living rooms and bedrooms.

A two-tier round stainless steel lunch container with a white twist-open lid. The vacuum-tight seal and locking clips help prevent leaks and keep food fresh. It is BPA free, dishwasher safe, and freezer safe.
Women's printed knit Bermuda pajama shorts in chambray blue, sized large. They have a comfortable elastic waistband and a relaxed fit. The one-of-a-kind print was drawn by the HUE design team.

A fully articulated 6-inch Falcon action figure from Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War. It includes detachable wing gears that convert the figure to flying mode, plus two optional pairs of hands. It is a collectible for fans of the film.
A red 3D-designed mesh decal for the radiator grille of a 2018 Kia Stinger. It is attached with adhesive double-sided tape. The part is made in Korea and is listed as new.

A stylized vinyl Pop figure of Thor from Avengers: Endgame, standing about 3.75 inches tall. The collectible is designed to display alongside other Endgame figures. It suits Marvel fans who collect stylized figures.
Cosplay training sweatpants inspired by My Hero Academia, sized XX-large. They are made of soft cotton and suit fans who want a costume look for conventions or casual wear.

A 9-foot beige market umbrella for patio tables with a tilt adjustment and crank lift. Its 100% polyester canopy is waterproof, fade resistant, and easy to clean. It is suited to covering patio dining sets and conversation seating.

A kids' flower-growing kit with a planter that can be decorated with vibrant paints, which can be mixed for new colors. Children grow their own flowers with bright colors and sweet scents. The kit is a hands-on way to learn about plants.

A men's walnut hiking shoe from Merrell's Moab 2 Vent line, sized 10.5 medium US. It has a suede and mesh upper, a bellows tongue, and a rubber toe cap. The Vibram sole with 5-millimeter lugs is built for trail traction.

A navy hardside carry-on spinner suitcase from Ben Sherman, sized 20 inches. It rolls on four multidirectional spinner wheels and has a durable ABS exterior with corner guards. The fully lined interior includes zippered organizers.

A lightweight draped open-front blazer for women in red, sized small with plus sizes also offered. It is classic in style and suits school, office, casual, and party occasions. Hand wash cold and hang or line dry.

A 120-piece air fort building kit for children that makes forts, tents, tunnels, and castles from flexible stems and a bed sheet. Kids can build a cave, rocket, igloo, or princess castle. It is designed to encourage creativity and imaginative play.

specs.support: memory foam with high arch support

record.description: Rechargeable memory foam insoles with heating elements and a power display for adjusting warmth. They include arch support and cushioning intended to help with flat feet. The insoles are designed for men and women who want warm feet.
Women's aviator sunglasses from Jessica Simpson with a 60-millimeter lens and metal frame. They are UV protective and designed to be comfortable to wear all day. The glam style suits any season.

Compression tights worn under jerseys for football, soccer, baseball, and other sports. They are made of 92 percent polyester and 8 percent spandex for a smooth, lightweight feel. They can be machine washed.
A men's heavyweight car coat in black, sized small, made of a warm wool-blend twill. It has a roomy fit through the chest and waist and a button-front closure. The coat suits cold-weather days.
A pack of 12 large silver metallic foil gift bows, each about 4.5 inches across. The bows have self-adhesive backing for easy application. They coordinate with curly ribbon bows and metallic banding.

A compact Bluetooth FM transmitter that plugs into a car and plays audio through the radio. It has four buttons, supports hands-free calling, and includes a dual car charger with QC3.0 quick charging. The device has a small footprint.

A red wild bird feeder for oriole jelly with a 32-ounce inverted bottle. An internal stirrer dispenses the right amount of jelly. The bottle can be swapped with most standard 32-ounce jelly jars and is easy to clean.

A king-size sheet set from Sferra's Grande Hotel collection, in white and grey. The collection is styled after sheets used in some of the finest hotels. The set is intended to bring a five-star hotel feel to the bed.
A set of 10 white 42-millimeter festoon LED bulbs for car interior dome, map, and trunk lights. Each bulb has 16 super bright 3528 SMD chips. The 6000K color temperature gives a bright white light.
A gray boat seat measuring 18 by 21 by 6 inches, built to mount on most boat pedestals. It has a weight capacity of 400 pounds and weighs about 8 pounds. The seat comes with a three-year warranty.

A classic hair dye in a deep cool fuchsia shade from Manic Panic. It is designed to create fuchsia tones on virgin unbleached hair, and the listing recommends lightening hair first for best results. The bold pink suits vivid color looks.

A women's mid-ankle leather hiking boot from Timberland in dark brown, sized 5 medium US. It has shock-absorbing cushioning and rubber lug outsoles for trail traction. The rugged style suits outdoor walking.

A structured Under Armour cap in academy blue with red accents, sized X-large to XX-large. It has a pre-curved visor and a classic fit. The Freedom line includes a commitment to support first responders, military personnel, and veterans.
A red 0.7 cubic foot Daewoo microwave with a turntable included. It is a compact countertop model suited to everyday reheating and cooking. The model number is KOR07R3ZER.

A royal blue flower crown headband with a 19-centimeter diameter that fits most heads. It is handmade and suits bridal, bridesmaid, and flower girl looks for weddings and festivals. The wreath has an elegant design.

A black Z-shaped gaming desk with a carbon fiber surface measuring 42.5 by 23.6 inches. It supports up to 280 pounds and includes storage, a cup holder, speaker holders, and a headphone hook. The large surface fits a computer, keyboard, and books.

A 1-inch 24K gold extra-long curling iron with a rotating cool tip and a heat-resistant mat. It reaches up to 430 degrees and has a rheostat temperature control. The barrel is about two inches longer than many standard irons.

Large high-visibility orange impact gloves from Mad Grip's F50 Thunderdome line. The gloves have seamless reinforcement in high-abrasion areas to add durability and dampen vibration. They are built for comfort and dexterity.

A blue 50cc two-stroke kids' dirt bike with an air-cooled engine and EPA approval. It is designed as a starter pit bike for young riders. The Demon model is part of the company's latest generation of mini bikes.

A 6000 mAh rechargeable battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7, and 8 that also works as a portable power bank. It lets you charge the phone without removing the case and sync data to a computer through the existing cable. The case adds extra battery life.

A rose gold glitter case for the iPhone XR, 6.1 inches, in a three-layer hybrid design. It provides full front and back coverage to absorb drops. The glitter finish is designed not to flake off or scratch fingers.

A leather folio wallet case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G with a 6.2-inch screen. It has nine card slots, a zipper coin pocket, and two side pockets. A magnetic closure, kickstand, and wrist strap are included.

A rectangular leaf net for a 16-by-32-foot swimming pool. It rests on top of a winter cover to catch leaves before they fall into the pool. The knitted polyethylene net is designed to be lifted off in one step.

A set of five replacement office chair casters in blue that roll quietly and protect floors. The patented design is intended to avoid the falling balls and pin fractures of standard casters. Chair mats are not needed with these wheels.

A refurbished Apple iPhone 8 with 64GB of storage in space gray, locked to AT&T. It works only with compatible carriers, so buyers should verify carrier support before use. The device is sold as a reconditioned phone rather than a new one.

An oversized floppy-brimmed costume bonnet in white with an Americana look, sized one size for most teens and adults. It is sold for costume and themed events. Red and black versions are also offered.

A heavy-duty sewing machine from Singer with a metal frame, 110 stitch applications, and a built-in needle threader. It includes an accessory kit for sewing garments and gifts. The machine is aimed at making sewing projects easier.
Men's green Chewbacca-themed socks from Stance in a large size. They have a seamless toe closure, arch support, and reinforced heel and toe. The socks are made for everyday wear.
A set of six 7-milliliter color-changing gel nail polishes in a gift box. The shades respond to temperature and suit holiday nail art. The gel must be cured under an LED lamp.

A set of four red ratchet tie-down straps, each 1 inch wide and 10 feet long, with a 900-pound break strength. Each set includes metal ratchet buckles, heavy-duty hooks, soft loop straps, and a mesh bag. Each strap is rated for workloads up to 300 pounds.

A set of three tall 5-ounce double-wall glass espresso cups that keep hot drinks warm and cold drinks cool. Their modern design suits cafes, restaurants, and home use. The cups are a stylish choice for coffee service.

A slim liquid silicone case for iPhone X and XS that covers all four edges. It has a reinforced microfiber inner lining that protects the back of the phone. The full-body design aims to add protection with a thin profile.

A neoprene insulated sleeve that holds a water bottle or longneck bottle, with drawstring tops to fit different sizes. It keeps drinks insulated and can be carried with a strap. The sleeve suits kids and adults on bike rides and travels.

A pack of 100 individually sealed sterile plastic 1-milliliter syringes with caps. Each syringe has a clear scale for measuring and dispensing liquids. They are sold for essential oil, perfume, and lab use.

A marble-design TPU case for iPhone 7, iPhone 8, and iPhone SE 2020 with a 360-degree rotating ring kickstand. The flexible thermoplastic polyurethane body is designed to be shockproof. Buyers should confirm their model before ordering.
A 60-inch industrial farmhouse writing desk in vintage oak with a sturdy metal frame. The large wood desktop holds monitors, a laptop, and books. It leaves room for writing accessories as well.

A men's tungsten carbide wedding band, 8 millimeters wide, with a rose gold line and a black and silver brushed finish. The matte outer surface contrasts with a high-polish smooth inner face. The comfort-fit design is made for everyday wear.

A chrome 8.5-inch spray rainshower showerhead from Moen with two functions. It uses self-pressurizing Immersion technology to channel water through the head. The mirror-like finish suits many decorating styles.

A two-piece set of federal blue terry cloth pocket mitts that work as both hot pads and pot holders. The pockets protect the hands while the mitts shield kitchen surfaces. They are made of 100 percent cotton.

A non-surgical bunion splint and toe separator for women and men that is meant to ease discomfort from bunions and crooked toes. It is designed to help straighten the big toe while worn. Listed uses include turf toe and overlapping toes.

A black automotive-grade thermoplastic front bumper bracket for mounting a license plate. It is made for Ford F-150 and Lincoln Mark LT models from 2006 to 2008 and includes license plate screws. Its heavy-duty build aims to hold the plate in place.

A vitamin C facial toner spray with witch hazel, designed to refresh skin and help with the look of pores. It contains MSM and is intended for sensitive, dry, and combination skin. The mist is meant to prepare skin for the rest of a skincare routine.

A 66-inch modern L-shaped corner desk with an iron hook, designed for home offices and gaming. The desk is about 66 by 47 inches and can hold three or more monitors. It is designed to be easy to assemble.

A carbon fiber key organizer that holds up to 20 keys in a compact, sturdy design. It includes a multifunctional SIM tool and bottle opener. The organizer is meant to keep keys from loosening over time.

An 11-by-6-inch airtight storage pouch with a carbon lining that is designed to keep odors contained. The bag is made to limit smells from escaping to the outside. It is useful for storing small items.

A 12-pound weighted blanket sized 48 by 72 inches for a twin bed, filled with glass beads. It is designed to provide gentle, hug-like pressure for adults. The listing warns against use on children under three and against covering the face.

A pack of two baby blue decorative throw pillow covers with 3mm sequins on one side and satin on the other. They are suitable for weddings, Christmas, and other celebrations. The covers are made from new, high-quality materials.

A bridal ring set with a pear-shaped cubic zirconia stone in size 6. The sparkly stones give a timeless look that works with casual or formal attire. The set is presented as a gift for a bride or bridesmaid.

A 17-by-12-inch oven-safe stainless steel baking rack for cooling and cooking. It is sized to fit most standard ovens and cookware sheets. The solid wire construction is intended for baking and roasting.
A 1-ounce bottle of black pigmented tattoo ink made in the USA. The listing describes it as heal-true and vibrant. It is listed as suitable for all types of tattoo art.

An adjustable brown synthetic leather crossbody bag strap with gold metal hardware. It extends from about 43 to 49 inches, including snap hooks. The double-layer band is 0.7 inches wide and suits replacement purse straps.
An 80-count bottle of nighttime sleep-aid tablets containing doxylamine succinate, one tablet per dose. The product is marketed to help people fall asleep and stay asleep. Read the label before use.

A set of six 12-ounce stemless champagne flutes made of BPA-free Tritan plastic. They are shatterproof and dishwasher safe, making them a practical choice for parties. The set is a durable alternative to glass.

specs.type: curly half wig with attached headband

record.description: A short curly synthetic wig in dark red with a headband attached. The 2-in-1 design is styled for everyday, work, travel, and party looks. The attached headband is meant to make the wig easy to put on.

A 100-inch 16:9 projector screen with a wrinkle-free matte PVC surface that is easy to clean. It has a 1.1 gain and a 160-degree viewing angle and is designed for indoor and outdoor use. The screen comes with a stand.
A 10-inch standard French whisk made in the USA from 18/8 stainless steel wires. It is NSF approved and sized for mixing bowls and sauce pans. The whisk is dishwasher safe.

A blue vinyl lion head decal, 3.7 inches wide and 5 inches tall, made in the USA. It removes cleanly without residue and includes installation instructions. The decal is an officially trademarked JS Artworks product.

A two-sided Puppy Dog Pals treehouse playset with seven pieces, based on the Disney Junior pre-school series. It includes the Keia figure and a two-story treehouse for action-packed play. Kids can recreate scenes from the show.

A pack of 25 three-ring binder pages for CDs and DVDs, holding 100 discs in total. Each page has four pockets with non-woven liners that guard against scratches. The pages fit standard three-ring binders.
A Bunn AXIOM-15-3 coffee brewer rated for 120 volts, 60 hertz, single phase. It is made in the United States and is sold as a single unit. The package measures about 27 by 56 by 61 centimeters.

Men's red waterproof insulated snow pants for skiing and snowboarding, sized medium with a 32-inch inseam. They have a polyester shell and lining with 120 grams of insulation and a down-proof layer. Zipper pockets provide storage on the slopes.

A 2.88-inch miniature sloth figurine on a tree from Enesco's Jim Shore Heartwood Creek collection. It features traditional quilt patterns and design motifs. The multicolor piece is a decorative display item.
A 10-yard spool of 2.5-inch wired fall plaid ribbon in orange, green, and red. It is woven from polyester with a small amount of metallic and nylon. The wired edges help shape bows and craft designs.

A men's classic-fit long-sleeve plaid shirt in Cesar yellow, sized small. It has a button-down front, cuffs, and collar, plus a single open pocket. The extra-long sleeves and tails and roomy shoulders and chest add comfort.

A five-string bass guitar from Ibanez in brown, with a maple neck and a spalted maple top over a mahogany body. The rosewood fretboard has white dot inlays and medium frets. The bass has a B15 bridge.
A 33-fluid-ounce fragrance-free body wash with oat that is soap-free and dye-free. It cleanses while aiming to soothe dry, itchy skin. The formula is designed for sensitive skin.

A zip-front organic footed sleeper for babies, sized newborn, with a loose fit that allows room to move. The non-slip bee grip on the feet helps babies stay steady. It is designed for both playtime and bedtime.

A compact 18-watt USB-C fast charger with a foldable plug and Power Delivery support. It is designed for iPhone 12 models and works with other devices that accept 30 watts or less. The compact body is convenient for travel.

A set of three nickel-plated candle stands with sculpted double-heart designs and rhinestone accents. The large stand fits a 3-inch diameter pillar candle. They suit unity candle lighting and romantic decor.
A men's black leather driving-style loafer from Lacoste's Concours 118 line, sized 7.5 US. The sleek design reflects the brand's French heritage. It suits everyday wear and dressier outfits.

A two-seat convertible loveseat with two pillows and foldable armrests, built on a hardwood frame. It works as a deep sofa or a space-saving sofa bed for a living room or balcony. The sofa ships from US warehouses in California and New Jersey.
A men's burgundy graphic t-shirt with a geisha flower garden design, sized X-large. It is made of 100% cotton with a soft wash finish and a tagless neck label. The shirt is machine washable.

A Buzz Lightyear costume for toddlers in size 2T, including a full bodysuit, soft fabric wings, gloves, and a hat. It has glitter accents and self-stick fabric tabs on the back for easy on and off. The costume is sold as an authentic Disney product.

A three-pack of reusable 304 stainless steel bent straws for drinking tea, lemon water, and cocktails. The flared base has small holes that filter out loose tea and chunky material. A cleaning brush is included for upkeep.

specs.subjects: reading, writing, math, science, social studies

record.description: A summer learning workbook that bridges grades 4 to 5 in about 15 minutes a day. It covers language arts, math, and science activities aligned to current state standards. The book includes stickers, flash cards, an award certificate, and an answer key.
A two-pack of gray woven cotton rope baskets in 12-inch and 10-inch sizes. They work as indoor planters, storage for crafts and toys, or towel baskets. The set comes in a range of designs and colors.

A men's black tonneau-style analog quartz dress watch from Bulova with a 44.5-millimeter stainless steel case and a leather-alligator strap. It is water resistant to 30 meters for splashes and brief immersion, but it is not meant for swimming.

A neoprene sunglass strap that floats and holds eyewear in place during water sports and outdoor activities. It fits around the head and keeps sunglasses from being lost. The retainer doubles as a lanyard-style cord.

Small plastic office storage bins with handles that fit filing cabinets, closet shelves, and desk drawers. They are designed to organize notes, pens, pencils, erasers, and other desk supplies. The bins help create a neat, tidy workspace.

A pack of two 18-by-18-inch cream chenille pillow covers with a soft, plush feel. They mix well with pillows made of fur, cotton, linen, or leather. The covers suit a couch, bed, or living room with a cozy winter look.

A 20-inch microwavable plush cord filled with grain and dried French lavender. It is meant to provide soothing warmth and comfort, and it meets listed US safety standards. The product is made for users of all ages.

A set of 12 soft foam blocks in primary colors for toddlers to build and play with. The brightly colored blocks encourage motor development and hand-eye coordination. They are designed for safe, active play.

A women's lightweight backpack from Vera Bradley in the tossed posies print. Its water-repellent fabric is durable and wipes clean. The multi-use bag is designed for travel, hiking, and everyday outings.

A slim, ultra-thin matte TPU case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max (2019 release). It is designed to keep the phone's original shape while adding little bulk. The case is not compatible with the iPhone 11 or 11 Pro.

A women's lightweight long-sleeve crewneck sweater in black, sized large. It has a classic fit that allows easy movement, plus ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem. The soft yarn is designed for everyday wear.

A 60-capsule supplement providing 250 micrograms of iodine from Ascophyllum nodosum sea kelp grown in the USA. It is marketed as a thyroid support supplement. Check with a health professional before taking supplements.

A water-resistant polyester carry-on backpack with an expandable design that increases capacity up to 40 liters. The bag is intended for three to seven days of travel gear. It suits travel and business trips.

A 75-milliliter tube of Mars Black acrylic paint from Sargent Art. The opaque paint dries to a waterproof finish and conforms to ASTM D 4236 for safety. It is made in India and comes in a tube that can be pegged on a display.
An extra-long striped Santa hat measuring 32 inches, with red and white stripes, trimmed fur, and a pom-pom topper. It fits most teens and adults. The hat completes a Christmas outfit.

A 28-inch expandable ABS checked upright suitcase in rose gold with eight multidirectional spinner wheels. It expands by an extra two inches and has zippered compartments, shoe pockets, and a garment restraint panel. Its handle is designed for comfortable handling.

A two-pack of men's white short-sleeve pocket t-shirts in extra large. They are made of pre-shrunk cotton with a left chest pocket and a tagless back neck label. Taped neck and shoulder seams are designed for longer wear.

A black padded vanity stool with solid wood legs, designed as a European-style makeup bench. It can hold up to 250 pounds and has a thickened MDF and solid pine frame. The stool is meant to stay steady rather than wobble.

A navy kitchen island with a 1.5-inch butcher block top for food prep and serving. It is built from solid hardwood and birch veneers. Casters and feet are both included, so it can be used as a movable cart or a stationary island.

A set of 60 permanent markers with fine tips in bright, assorted colors. They write on plastic, wood, stone, metal, and glass for doodling, coloring, and marking. The set is versatile for crafts and everyday projects.

Men's grey Superstar sneakers from Golden Goose in leather with a blue star detail, sized 8 US. The mix of materials and textures gives a distinctive look. The sneakers are made of cowhide leather and polyester for a soft, light feel.
A men's grey slip-on sneaker from Quiksilver, sized 13 medium US. Its no-sew mesh upper is welded to molded underlays for a performance fit. The shoe is built for everyday casual wear.

A white marine digital media receiver from Sony with Bluetooth and 6.5-inch dual cone speakers. It has an IPx5 water-resistant design, a front USB port, and SiriusXM radio readiness. It plays MP3, WMA, AAC, WAV, and FLAC files.

A 150-watt switching power supply module that converts 100 to 240 volts AC to 24 volts DC at 6 to 9 amps. It is a bare board with over-voltage, over-current, and short-circuit protection. The double-sided PCB design is meant to be stable and reliable.

A non-shedding 8-by-10-foot area rug with a modern ombre pattern in silver and black. Its stain-resistant synthetic fibers have a 0.45-inch pile. The rug is designed for living rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms, and offices, and is listed as safe for kids and pets.

A black faux fur throw blanket measuring 50 by 60 inches, with plush fur on the front and sherpa on the back. The soft fabric is designed to feel like mink. It is meant to wrap up on a couch or bed for warmth.
A women's yellow slide sandal from Ted Baker's Avelini collection, sized 8.5 regular US. It is a slip-on slide style for casual warm-weather wear. The listing has limited product details.
A 16-by-16-inch multicolor throw pillow with a humorous campfire design and white lettering. It reads that camping without beer is just sitting in the woods. The pillow suits campers and beer fans.

A six-pair pack of men's no-show socks from adidas in large, fitting shoe sizes 6 to 12. The Superlite construction is lightweight, and the moisture-wicking yarn keeps feet dry. The socks have a wordmark knit on the outside of the foot.

Black ballet flats with a round toe, elastic ankle strap, and contoured sole for a snug, comfortable fit. The thick cushioned sole is designed for walking. The slip-on flats suit everyday and dress-casual wear.

A 24-by-24-inch giclee canvas print of gray and yellow blossom flowers. It is printed on waterproof archival-quality canvas and is available in other sizes. The abstract floral art suits living rooms, bedrooms, and offices.

A full-figure underwire lace bra from Wacoal in ivory, sized 34G. Its two-part seamed full-coverage cups are built for lift and support. A sheer mesh window at the top of the cups adds a feminine detail, and a leotard back completes the design.

Individual eyelash extensions in mixed lengths from 8 to 15 millimeters, with 0.07 and 0.10 millimeter thickness options. They are made of silk mink material offered in several curl types. The lashes are described as black and soft for salon use.

A natural-colored indoor and outdoor cuddle and play lounge that transforms into a backpack in one motion. It weighs less than four pounds and includes a removable activity bar and canopy. The base is waterproof and machine washable.

A heavy-duty shockproof protective case for iPod touch 5th, 6th, and 7th generation models. It offers slim full-body protection and does not fit the iPod touch 4. The case is designed to absorb impacts from everyday use.

A reusable frosted plastic pump dispenser for liquid soap, dish soap, hand sanitizer, or essential oils. Its round, compact design fits most bathroom sinks and countertops. The bottle can be refilled easily.

A six-piece set of black polycuramine concrete coating from Rust-Oleum for interior surfaces such as garage floors, basements, and workshops. The self-leveling, buildable formula is marketed as stronger than epoxy. It is applied as a floor coating.

A silver wireless Magic Trackpad 2 from Apple with a rechargeable built-in battery. Four force sensors beneath the surface let you click anywhere and detect differences in pressure. It brings Force Touch to the desktop.

A pack of 68 natural vetiver incense sticks, 11 inches long and weighing 200 grams. Vetiver has a heavy, woodsy, earthy, and sweet scent that suits meditation, yoga, and aromatherapy. The light scent is intended for calm, relaxing settings.

An unlined dotted mesh bralette in black caviar from Savage X Fenty, sized large. It has stretch lace trim at the cups, underarm, and underband. The adjustable double rouleau straps and rose gold tone hardware complete the look.

A red countertop pizza oven with a removable stone for crisp, even baking. It has upper and lower heating elements, a preheating function, and variable temperature control up to 625 degrees. It works with frozen, pre-baked, or fresh dough.

A women's black three-in-one winter ski jacket in medium with an anorak style. Its polyester pongee shell resists water and grease while helping keep sweat out. It is designed to match a men's jacket for a coordinated look.

A one-size feather headdress costume accessory with large faux feathers in black, white, and blue and white marabou trim on the sides. It fits most teens and adults. The headdress is intended for role-playing and costume parties.

A women's Rolex Lady-Datejust automatic watch, reference 179178, with an 18k yellow gold bracelet and bezel. It has a white dial in the Datejust style. The listing identifies it as a President Datejust model.

A six-pair pack of women's crew socks with patterns and solid rainbow colors, made in Korea. The assortment includes red socks and other bright shades. The socks are designed as a colorful everyday option.

A 2-in-1 matte lip crayon with a built-in lip balm that delivers buildable color. The balm can be used alone or layered on top for shine and hydration. The kit works as a lipstick, lip liner, and lip gloss balm.

A 9-foot beige patio table umbrella with a push-button tilt for adjusting sun shade and UV protection. It has rectangular steel ribs, a heavy-duty aluminum frame, and a crank for lifting. The umbrella base stand is sold separately.
A four-pack of 11.5-ounce, three-wick scented candles in glass jars with a mulled cider fragrance. The jars hold about 22 ounces with the glass included. Store them in a cool place for best results.

A soft nude mid-thigh shaping short from SPANX's Thinstincts line, sized small. It has a shaping panel for tummy control and a lightweight microfiber fabric. The design is meant to avoid pinching, and a cotton gusset is included.

A four-pack of girls' racerback seamless crop cami bralettes from Reebok in all white, sized 6 to 7. They have removable pads and are tag free for comfort. The stretchy nylon and spandex blend suits active kids.

A women's 6-inch waterproof work boot from Timberland PRO in Turkish coffee, sized 8. It has an alloy safety toe and premium full-grain leather with a waterproof membrane. The anti-fatigue footbed and all-weather outsole are designed for industrial and construction work.

A compact waterproof 10x25 binocular from Leica's Ultravid BR line in black. Its AquaDura lens coating and optics are designed for sharp resolution and strong suppression of stray light. The binocular suits detailed viewing at long distances.

A slim shell stand case for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S4 10.5-inch 2018 tablet, with a detachable wireless Bluetooth keyboard. The case includes backlight modes and folds into a stand. It is not compatible with the Tab A 10.5 2018 model.

A pack of 100 colorful disposable plastic straws for smoothies and milkshakes. Each straw is 0.43 inches in diameter and 8.2 inches long to handle thick drinks. The mixed bright colors are assigned at random.

A women's purple lace-up rock climbing and bouldering shoe from CLIMBX, sized 12.5. It is shaped for the higher instep and narrower heel common to female feet. The lace closure allows fine adjustment for a precise fit.

A box of 25 green letter-size laminated twin-pocket folders that hold up to 100 sheets. Each high-gloss folder has an interior die-cut business card holder. The folders suit client presentations and professional leave-behinds.

Convertible winter mittens that flip into fingerless gloves using magnets, with Thinsulate 3M insulation. The design frees the fingers for fishing, texting, photography, or running. They are made for ice fishing and cold-weather activities.
Men's slim-fit flat-front dress pants in black, sized 28 by 28. They are fitted through the hip and thigh with a tapered leg. The silky twill polyester fabric moves easily for everyday dressing.

A women's off-white hooded jacket from Save The Duck in size 2, made of 100% nylon. It is lined with faux sheepskin that is described as light, soft, and warm. The jacket is machine washable up to 30 degrees Celsius.

A six-pair pack of unisex baby crew socks in blue, sized 6 to 12 months. They have a mesh and thermal stretch construction for year-round wear. Cushioned soles and non-skid grippers add comfort and grip.
A 25-yard spool of 1.5-inch hot red sheer organza wired ribbon for bows and wreaths. The ribbon is described as waterproof and holds its color through washing. It suits floral and outdoor crafts.

A 3-inch preformed lap joint exhaust band clamp made of 304 stainless steel. It joins 3.0-inch outside diameter pipe to 3.0-inch inside diameter pipe in heavy-duty exhaust systems. The strap is about 2.94 inches wide.

A seamless 9-by-12-foot heavy-weight drop cloth made of 100 percent cotton canvas. It protects floors and furniture during painting and other home projects. The canvas construction is built to hold up to repeated use.

A pack of 30 disposable clear plastic martini glasses holding about 5 ounces each. The stemmed cups are used for desserts, mousse, and appetizers at weddings and parties. They are disposable, so cleanup is quick.

A two-case pack of 24 white athletic field marking paint cans, each holding 18 ounces. It is formulated for line striping athletic fields and fits most competitor aerosol machines. The paint gives single-coat coverage and dries quickly.

Unisex rectangular Gucci sunglasses in dark havana with gold accents, sized 57 millimeters. The lens width is 57 millimeters with an 18-millimeter bridge. The style is model GG-0381-S, color code 008.
A 0.17-ounce splash of Versace Eros Pour Femme eau de parfum for women. It is a small travel-size fragrance. The listing provides no further details on the scent.

A women's long, hooded down jacket from Columbia's McKay Lake line in black, sized medium. It is filled with 650-fill down and is water resistant. The jacket has secure hand pockets and dual zippers for a lightweight, warm layer.

A mini quadcopter drone called the LF606, with altitude hold and a foldable design for easy travel. Its replaceable arm can be swapped if a motor or arm breaks. The base drone ships without a camera, and camera options are sold separately.

Three pairs of reusable silicone ear plugs in different sizes for sleeping and noise reduction. The oval, ergonomic shape fits the ear canal, and ear hooks help keep them in place during sleep. They are designed for quiet rest.

A women's high-rise A-line maxi denim skirt in light blue, sized XL with a 35-inch length. It has contrast stitching, a curved waist, and functional front and back pockets. Three buttons and a zipper close the waist.

Women's mid-rise 7/8-length active leggings in black with blue side stripes, sized large. They have a flat, wide waistband and flatlock stitching for comfort. The full-coverage leggings are built for sport and training.

An oval embossed tin sign from Harley-Davidson with an Enjoy the Ride graphic, measuring 18 by 10.5 inches. The die-cut graphic is embossed on the front, and the sign has holes for hanging. It makes a gift for Harley enthusiasts.
A four-pack of oversized square reading glasses for women with spring hinges. The frame is about 47 millimeters high. The set provides four pairs for everyday reading.

A smoke-colored ultra-thin soft silicone case for iPhone 7 Plus and iPhone 8 Plus, with a skeleton graphic. It covers the phone for protection with a slim fit. Only the case is included; the phone is not.

A pack of eight holiday-colored over-dyed cotton embroidery floss skeins from DMC. Each six-strand skein is 8.7 yards long, with a variegated effect for multicolored stitching. The floss suits cross-stitch and other embroidery projects.

An 85-inch 4K UHD QLED smart TV from Samsung's Q60A series, with quantum dot color and Quantum HDR. It has dual LED backlights for contrast and built-in Alexa. The 2021 model is labeled QN85Q60AAFXZA.

A matching 18K white gold promise ring set for couples, with a round inlaid stone of about 0.04 carats. The women's ring is sized 6.5 and the men's is sized 10.5. The set is presented as a gift for anniversaries and Valentine's Day.

A men's long-sleeve fishing shirt with a tribal fish print and Omni-Shade UV protection. The tight weave with UV-absorbent yarns is designed to block UVA and UVB rays. Omni-Wick moisture management is meant to keep the shirt comfortable on the water.

A five-pack of men's tag-free A-shirts in X-large, made of 100 percent cotton in solid colors and a 90-10 cotton blend for sport grey. The moisture-wicking fabric helps keep the wearer cool and dry. The double-needle hem is designed for durability.

specs.strap: 20 mm leather with quick-release spring bars

record.description: A black leather-strap smartwatch from Timex's IQ+ Move line with a white dial and green hour markers. The 20-millimeter strap has quick-release spring bars and fits up to an eight-inch wrist. A sub-dial displays activity or a second time zone.

A kids' black and white running shoe from New Balance in size 3.5 Big Kid. It has a BOA fit system for precise adjustment, a breathable synthetic and mesh upper, and a lightweight REVlite midsole. The rubber outsole provides traction.

An adjustable blade hair clipper from Andis in black and chrome. Its patent-pending XTR technology reduces temperature while staying quiet and efficient. The ProAlloy design is said to run cooler and quieter than the Envy Clipper.

A women's long-sleeve white ribbed knit tee in size large, with an asymmetrical cross-wrap neckline and a slim fit. It is a solid pullover blouse for everyday wear. The listing advises that it runs small, so check the size chart.

Clip-on flashing heel wheels that turn regular shoes into roller skates, designed for kids age six and up. The dark blue pair is meant for school runs and quick trips. The flashing lights add fun for kids on the move.

A one-roll matte white graphic art tape from Chartpak, 1/8 inch wide and 324 inches long. It creates even, solid lines for charts, signage, and crafts. The permanent adhesive works on indoor and outdoor surfaces that are clean and dry.

A wooden PAW Patrol-themed toddler bed from Delta Children, recommended for ages 15 months and up. It has two high side rails for safety during the transition to a big kid bed. The assembled bed measures about 54.5 by 29.9 by 18.9 inches.

A pair of ivory linen-look textured sheer curtain panels, each 52 by 84 inches, with eight silver grommets at the top. The voile fabric is soft and elegant for bedrooms and living rooms. The bottom hem is 0.4 inches.

An 11-by-14-inch magnetic dry erase whiteboard with an aluminum frame, suited for reminders, lists, and drawings. It doubles as a bulletin board for photos and notes. The set includes a marker and two magnets.

A 12-pack of reusable PEVA storage bags, including sandwich, snack, and large bags with zipper closures. The food-grade material is described as BPA free, PVC free, and lead free. The bags are designed to cut down on disposable plastic use.

A seven-pack of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in assorted colors, sized 18 months. The strong snaps are designed to hold up through repeated washing. The set provides everyday layering for baby.

A vanilla plant-based collagen builder protein powder that is non-GMO, gluten free, dairy free, and vegan. It is marketed for skin hydration, joint support, and healthy hair. Check with a health professional before use.

Six refill bulbs of Bath and Body Works Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin Wallflowers fragrance. The scent blends spicy pumpkin puree with sweet butter and vanilla cream. The fragrance is discontinued, so refills may be hard to find.

A box of mixed pre-packaged snacks from countries including Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, and Ukraine. Each box can contain a different combination of candy and other snacks. The box is packed and shipped from the USA.

A black skull-shaped resin shift knob with an aluminum alloy attachment, designed to fit most automatic and manual vehicles. Its smooth finish offers a comfortable grip for the driver. The knob is made to suit a range of shifters.

A kit of 200 ivory plastic floating pearls with no holes, plus six packets of water gels for floating them. The pearls come in 20-millimeter, 14-millimeter, and 10-millimeter sizes. They suit homemade jewelry, wedding decor, and event centerpieces.

specs.includes: bassinet stroller and SnugRide SnugLock 35 car seat

record.description: A Graco Modes Bassinet travel system in Wynton that includes a bassinet stroller and a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. The stroller works as a bassinet, infant car seat carrier, and toddler stroller. It is designed for riding from birth through toddler age.
A white 24-inch countryside flower box tray that fits 24-inch flower boxes. It is made of lightweight, fade-resistant plastic and protects decks, patios, or indoor surfaces from water.

A medium undershelf storage basket in light blue with a rust-resistant steel frame. It measures 16 by 5.5 inches and has snug-fit arms for cabinets and pantry shelves. The basket holds plates, spices, and napkins.

A tiny 24-karat gold-plated heart locket, 0.75 by 0.5 inches, that holds up to two photos. It is available with or without an 18-inch curb link chain and comes in a black velvet pouch for gift giving. The locket is made to last.
A brass Kaweco Sport fountain pen with a fine gold-plated steel nib. It weighs 21 grams and has a classic design in historical brass colors. The pen is praised for its smooth, soft writing feel.

Self-fanning volume eyelash extensions in blue, with lengths from 14 to 20 millimeters and 0.07-millimeter thickness. They are designed for lash technicians and bloom automatically for quick application. The lashes also come in red, green, brown, and purple.

A weathered white wood wall-mounted coat rack with five metal hooks for jackets, hats, purses, and umbrellas. Its rustic distressed finish and antique-style hooks add charm to an entry, kitchen, or bedroom. The rack helps organize small spaces.

A stainless steel boot hanger for drying fishing and hunting waders. It is made of 1/4-inch heavy-duty steel with a chain design that helps waders keep their natural shape during storage. The hanger is sturdy and durable.

A men's full-zip jacket from Spyder with a bonded grid-knit fleece exterior and a Sherpa fleece lining. It has two side zipper pockets and an embroidered logo on the front. The jacket is made of 100 percent polyester.

A chocolate-colored pet stair for small, medium, and large dogs, helping them reach couches and higher beds. The carpet tread is removable for easy cleaning. The stairs are made of blow-molded plastic with a slight incline on each step.

A satin black Cross Tech3+ multifunction pen with custom engraving of up to 25 characters, completed in one business day. The deep cut engraving shows as silver. The pen is sold by Dayspring Pens as a personalized gift.

A black short-sleeve Raiders fan t-shirt in X-large with a 'True Til the Day I'm Through' design, screen printed in the USA. It is 100% cotton, pre-shrunk, and machine washable. The design is a copyrighted creation of Smack Apparel.
A boys' flip-flop sandal from Reef in aqua and green, sized 11 to 12 medium US little kid. The soft EVA footbed has anatomical arch support. It suits casual wear and water play.

A white kids' home jersey in the style of Real Madrid's 2019-20 kit, sized medium. It has short sleeves and a crewneck, and is made of 100 percent recycled polyester. Mesh inserts under the arms add breathability for active play.
A 7-foot HDTV cable for Saturn consoles, supporting 720p resolution with a clear picture and crisp audio. It includes a 6-foot micro cable. The cable is compatible with HDTVs and all Saturn models.

Silver mirror polarized replacement lenses for Oakley Holbrook sunglasses, 1.4 millimeters thick, with added UV protection. The dark silver mirror coating has 6 percent light transmission. The lenses are designed to fit Holbrook frames securely.

A women's thong sandal from Bionica's Nimah line, sized 9 B medium US. It has fabric straps, a soft nubuck toe post, and a quick-drying molded EVA footbed with arch support. The slip-resistant rubber outsole suits beach and water wear.
A heavyweight jumbo pet bowl from JW Pet Company with a rubber bottom that grips slippery floors. The bowl is dishwasher safe and suits extra-large breed dogs. It comes in assorted colors.

An unframed LEGO Batman grid wall poster measuring 22.375 by 34 inches, printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper. It is ready to frame or can be hung with poster mounts, clips, or thumb tacks. The art is official Trends International merchandise.

A three-pack of toddler boys' sleeveless tank tops in blue stripe, orange gators, and gray stripe, sized 3T. The ribbed neckline and pocket detail are simple everyday features. The packaging is tagless.

A double-wall kraft gaylord bottom for consolidating large shipments, measuring 48 by 40 by 36 inches. It is made from 275-pound double-wall corrugated board and protects bulky, irregularly shaped items. A pack of 75 bottoms is sold, and lids are sold separately.

A black water-resistant PU leather sling bag with adjustable nylon straps and an anti-theft design. It has a USB charge port and weighs about 0.69 pounds. The compact bag can be worn on the back, chest, or shoulder.

specs.sentiment: The best gift is time spent with you

record.description: A hand-painted resin figure of a grandmother seated on a gray bench holding hands with a young girl, both in cream dresses. It stands 5.5 inches tall and comes with an enclosure card that reads 'The best gift is time spent with you.' The sculpted piece celebrates family.

A heavy-duty multitool from Leatherman's Surge line with 21 tools, including replaceable wire cutters and spring-action scissors. It has a stainless steel body and a premium nylon sheath. The tool is built with the brand's largest pliers and multitool blades.

A white short-sleeve double-breasted chef's coat for women in small, with ten buttons and a matching chef hat. The jacket can be worn both ways, and the hat fastens with Velcro. Choose the size by bust measurement from the size chart.

Anti-slip 3-millimeter neoprene gloves for diving, kayaking, snorkeling, and paddling for women, men, and kids. The form-fitting, flexible design is soft and comfortable and reduces hand fatigue. They are built to keep hands warm in water.

specs.care: machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Juniors' denim shortalls from WallFlower in small, with a 3-inch cuffed inseam and adjustable straps. They have multiple pockets, a center-front zipper closure, and a soft denim feel. The shortalls are machine washable in cold water and tumble dry low.

A USB-C hub with four USB 3.0 ports that transfer data up to 5 gigabits per second, plus a Type-C charging port. It is plug and play and works with Windows, Chrome OS, and macOS. The hub suits keyboards, mice, flash drives, and hard drives.

An 18-by-24-inch museum quality poster of Alex Grey's Oversoul artwork, sold as an official item. The poster's text describes human consciousness as a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness. It is a decorative art print.

A foldable rocking camp chair from ALPS Mountaineering in deep sea and charcoal. Its powder-coated steel frame is designed for stability, and the breathable TechMesh fabric provides a comfortable rocking seat. It folds compactly and includes a shoulder strap for carrying.

A pack of two size D replica Good Guy batteries from the Child's Play 2 film, produced by Trick or Treat Studios under license from Universal Studios. They are a collectible prop-style item for fans of the franchise.
